resources.string: Low-power mode: it connects when you switch the bike on
Keep waiting for the bike in low-power mode

After 20 minutes without the bike, instead of giving up, the app checks now and then whether the bike\'s Wi-Fi is up (it only exists with the ignition on) and connects by itself. No wake locks: it\'s quickest when you look at your phone.
Take a photo of where you leave the bike (floor, bay number…)
Couldn\'t take the photo. Try again.
The camera can\'t start on this phone. Use \"Import QR from photo\" with a screenshot or photo of the dash QR instead.
